title: VisionReceiptRequest
description: vision.receipt-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/receipt. The local OCR reader extracts line items and a total; `fallback` asks OpenVibe.AI only when the local pass could not produce both.

image.description: The image as a data URL (base64).

image_url.description: A public image URL, fetched through Vision's private-address guard.
